scripts.text:
[Lady]
A long time ago,
when Payon was still
developing, many of the
villagers lived in poverty.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
很久以前，
当斐扬还在发展时，
许多村民都生活在贫困之中。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Many families had to struggle to survive, and often could not even afford to properly bury their dead. Some people threw their dead into the cave near the village.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
许多家庭为了生存苦苦挣扎，
甚至常常连体面地安葬死者都做不到。
有些人会把死者丢进村庄附近的洞穴里。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
So in that cave, it is said that there are many walking Zombies,
the dead who cannot rest in peace and are unable to pass on to the next world.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
据说那个洞穴里有很多行走的腐尸，
那些无法安息、
也无法前往下一个世界的亡者。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
The Zombies, upon sensing the warmth of a human, begin to assault them, but that doesn't mean these Undead hold a grudge against
the living.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
腐尸一旦感知到活人的体温，
就会发起攻击，
但这并不意味着这些亡灵对生者怀有怨恨。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Their rotten bodies can't leave the cold, dark and damp cave, so it's instinctual for them to attack warmth which would speed up the decomposition of their bodies.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
它们腐朽的身体无法离开寒冷、黑暗且潮湿的洞穴，
所以攻击温暖是它们的本能，
因为温暖会加速它们身体的腐烂。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
The Zombies in the Payon Cave
may be spooky, but their story
is also kind of tragic.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
斐扬洞穴里的腐尸
虽然看起来很吓人，
但它们的故事其实也有些悲惨。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
From your attire,
I can see that you
are a stranger here.
Welcome to Payon.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
从你的穿着来看，
我能看出你是这里的外乡人。
欢迎来到斐扬。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
You must be a well-experienced fighter, otherwise you'd never be able to arrive here after passing the steep, mountainous areas and dangerous creatures surrounding this city.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
你一定是一位经验丰富的格斗家，
否则你绝不可能穿过陡峭的山路和危险的生物，
抵达这座城镇。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I'm no expert at fighting, but someone once told me that sheer strength alone won't be able to win some battles.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我并不是战斗专家，
但有人曾告诉我，
仅凭蛮力是无法赢得所有战斗的。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Sometimes, you may encounter creatures protected by a hard-shell that don't be damaged by physical attacks. Only psychic power, like Magic, can easily defeat such creatures.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
有时候，你可能会遇到拥有坚硬外壳的生物，
物理攻击对它们无效。
只有像魔法这样的精神力量，
才能轻松击败它们。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Of course, not everyone can study magic. The point is that you should keep different kinds of friends and comrades close to you, as you can't possibly handle every situation by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
当然，不是每个人都能学习魔法。
重点在于，你应该结交各种各样的朋友和同志，
因为你不可能独自应对所有情况。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I remember the story my dearly departed grandfather has told me.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我记得我亲爱的爷爷给我讲过的故事。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
It's about this Amulet that possesses an Evil Power.
With it, you could awaken
the Dead from the Grave.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
那是关于一个拥有邪恶力量的护身符。
有了它，你就能从坟墓中唤醒死者。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Well, I'm not sure if it's true or not. But, I wonder, what would happen if I used it to summon
my grandfather from the other realm....
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
嗯，我不确定这是真是假。
但我在想，如果我用它从彼岸召唤我的爷爷回来....

scripts.text:
[?]
^3299CCNever think
of such a thing...
My son.^000000
scripts.translation:
[?]
^3299CC千万别有这种念头...
我的孩子。^000000

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
EEEEEEK-!
What was that?!
G-grandpa...?
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
啊啊啊——！
那是什么？！
爷...爷爷...？

scripts.text:
[Guardsman]
This is the Central Palace of Payon. This place is open to the public, but in accordance with our laws, you must behave in an orderly fashion once inside.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
这里是斐扬的中央宫。
这里对公众开放，但根据我们的法律，
进入后必须保持秩序。

scripts.text:
[Guardsman]
In the interest of protecting the peace, we will disarm your equipment once you enter.
Your cooperation is
much appreciated.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
为了维护和平，
进入后我们会没收你的装备。
感谢您的配合。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Welcome to Payon.
You must have had
a hard time getting
through the Payon Forest.
How was your trip?
scripts.translation:
[女子]
欢迎来到斐扬。
你一定在穿越斐扬树林时
经历了不少艰难吧。
旅途如何？

scripts.text:
[Woman]
We've been receiving less tourists because of the increasing numbers of monsters outside, so it's quieter nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
由于外面魔物数量增加，
游客变少了，
所以最近这里很安静。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
 To be honest, things are getting tough because of all those monsters. ^666666*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[女子]
说实话，
因为那些魔物，
日子过得挺艰难的。
^666666*叹气...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Whoa~! I just noticed those arms of yours look pretty solid. You look pretty strong, guy. Just how many monsters have you killed?!
scripts.translation:
[女子]
哇~！
我刚才注意到你的手臂很结实。
你看起来很强壮，盖伊。
你到底杀了多少魔物？！

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Oooh! I didn't notice before, but you look pretty strong beneath all of that feminine charm.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
噢噢！
我之前没注意到，
但在你温柔的外表下，
你看起来很强壮。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Hey, I know of a good place for you to hunt. It just so happens that there's a cave in the middle of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
嘿，我知道一个适合你打猎的好地方。
斐扬中间刚好有个洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
If you're interested, just head North, pass the forest, and go towards the Northwest. You'll know you've arrived when you're in the place filled with the smell of stinky monsters.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
如果你感兴趣，
就往北走，穿过树林，
然后往西北方向去。
当你闻到充满臭气魔物的地方时，
你就到了。

scripts.text: It sounds dangerous!
scripts.translation: 听起来很危险！

scripts.text: I better prepare myself...!
scripts.translation: 我得先做好准备...！

scripts.text: That's a nice dress you're wearing~
scripts.translation: 你穿的裙子真漂亮~

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Oh come on, don't be a coward.
It's just a simple cave filled with normal monsters. It's quite safe. We've even established an Archer Village near that cave to prevent misfortune incidents. Hohoohoho~
scripts.translation:
[女子]
哎呀，别当胆小鬼。
那只是一个充满普通魔物的简单洞穴。
很安全的。
我们甚至在那个洞穴附近建立了弓箭手村，
以防止不幸事件发生。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Oh don't worry about any preparations. There's a Tool Dealer right in front of the cave, so you can purchase anything you need from my husband, er, that guy~
scripts.translation:
[女子]
别担心准备什么。
洞穴正前方就有一个工具商人，
你可以从我丈夫，呃，那个家伙那里
买到任何你需要的东西~

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Oh hohohoho!
So you've noticed?
I hear this is the
latest trend in Prontera
these days.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
哦呵呵呵！
你注意到了？
我听说这是最近
普隆德拉的流行趋势。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Most of the women in this town don't know anything about fashion! My husband bought this for me as
a present. He makes quite a lot of money, you know. Hohohoho~
scripts.translation:
[女子]
这个镇上的大多数女人
什么都不懂时尚！
这是我丈夫买给我的礼物。
你知道的，他赚了不少钱。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Jim's Mother]
Oh boy~
There she goes again.
Without a doubt, that
woman is the town gossip.
scripts.translation:
[吉姆的母亲]
哎呀~
她又开始了。
毫无疑问，
那个女人是镇上的大嘴巴。

scripts.text:
[Jim's Mother]
Please don't judge the rest
of the people living in Payon by her behavior. She's the only loudmouth. I guess she's just too excited about what the fortune teller told her.
scripts.translation:
[吉姆的母亲]
请不要用她的行为
来评判斐扬的其他居民。
她只是唯一的大嘴巴。
我想她只是对算命师告诉她的话太兴奋了。

scripts.text:
[Jim's Mother]
Ooh...!
You've got
such broad shoulders!
Will you go out with me?
I'll treat you to
a nice dinner~
scripts.translation:
[吉姆的母亲]
噢...！
你的肩膀真宽！
你愿意和我约会吗？
我请你吃顿好的~

scripts.text:
[Jim's Mother]
My, you're a pretty girl!
I'm sure you're always busy
beating the boys away with a stick...
Or a well timed insult joke.
scripts.translation:
[吉姆的母亲]
哎呀，你真漂亮！
我相信你总是忙着
用棍子赶走那些男孩...
或者用恰到好处的讽刺笑话。

scripts.text: Fortune Teller...?
scripts.translation: 算命师...？

scripts.text: Well, see you later~
scripts.translation: 嗯，回头见~

scripts.text:
[Jim's Mother]
Oh yes...
There's an extraordinary fortune teller in the Central Palace of Payon. The more Zeny you pay her, the better fortune you'll get!
scripts.translation:
[吉姆的母亲]
哦对了...
斐扬的中央宫里有一位非凡的算命师。
你付给她的Zeny越多，
得到的运势就越好！

scripts.text:
[Jim's Mother]
She told me
I would meet
a nice guy this month.
Hohohoho~
scripts.translation:
[吉姆的母亲]
她说我
这个月会
遇到一个不错的家伙。
呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Jim's Mother]
Mmmm...?
You don't have
any time to stay
and chit-chat with me?
scripts.translation:
[吉姆的母亲]
嗯...？
你难道没有
时间留下来
和我聊聊天吗？

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Hey...
H-Hey...!

[Drunkard]
I wonder why those
stupid Archers even
bother trying to aim!
You're all weak!
Weeeeak!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
我真不明白那些
愚蠢的弓箭手
为什么要费劲瞄准！
你们都很弱！
太弱了！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Bwahahahaha!
Buy me a drink?!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
请我喝一杯？！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
An Archer!
Oh man, you guys!
You guys are the best!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
是个弓箭手！
天哪，你们这些家伙！
你们是最棒的！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Bwahahahaha!
Buy me a drink?!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
请我喝一杯？！

scripts.text: Alright, but only one drink.
scripts.translation: 好吧，但只喝一杯。

scripts.text: No thanks, pal.
scripts.translation: 不用了，朋友。

scripts.text: Oh my God! Hell no!
scripts.translation: 天哪！绝对不行！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Thanks...!
..Brother!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
谢...谢了！
...兄弟！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Most people don't even wanna
buy me drinks! Maybe cuz I used to fool around too much with the ladies back in my day!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
大多数人甚至都不愿意
请我喝酒！也许是因为我当年
跟女士们玩得太疯了吧！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Though, the women I used to play with are grannies now! Hahahaha! One of them still primps herself with makeup and stuff! Can you believe that?!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
不过，我当年玩弄过的女人们
现在都成老奶奶了！哈哈哈！
其中还有一个还在涂脂抹粉打扮自己！
你能相信吗？！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
I'm like...
Come on...!
Some faces are
beyond fixing!
Oh? I made a funny!
Bwahahahahahah!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
我是说...
拜托...！
有些脸
怎么修都修不好！
哦？我讲了个笑话！
哇哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
^666666*Gulp~ Gulp~*^000000
Man, this is great!
You the maaaaaaan~!
Muhahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
^666666*咕咚~ 咕咚~*^000000
天哪，真不错！
你真是个大...大好人~！
穆哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Bah!
Kids nowadays!
Now respect for
their elders! Fine!
I'm not gonna beg you!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
哼！
现在的年轻人！
对长辈
一点尊重都没有！算了！
我才不乞求你呢！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Fine...!
Fine by me!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
好吧...！
随你便！

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
Nice to meet you.
I am called Vuicokk.
I am a scholar in the Monster Research organization of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Do you have any questions about monsters?
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
很高兴见到你。
我叫维科克。
我是卢恩·米德加兹王国怪物研究组织的学者。你有什么关于魔物的问题吗？

scripts.text: Any news?
scripts.translation: 有什么新闻吗？

scripts.text: Undead Monsters?
scripts.translation: 不死系魔物？

scripts.text: Monster Research Organization?
scripts.translation: 怪物研究组织？

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
Payon is located deep inside the forest where it can easily be attacked by hordes of monsters. Monsters also come from the dangerous cave located near town.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
斐扬位于森林深处，很容易遭到成群魔物的袭击。此外，靠近城镇的危险洞穴里也常有魔物出没。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
Since Undead monsters roam the Payon Cave, it has attracted the attention of the monster academic world. My job here is to analyze their characteristics.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
由于斐扬洞穴中有不死系魔物徘徊，引起了魔物学术界的关注。我在此的工作就是解析它们的特性。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
What is most remarkable of the Undead monsters in Payon is their origin Most of them used to be citizens of Payon!
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
斐扬的不死系魔物最引人注目的地方在于它们的起源。它们大多数曾经是斐扬的市民！

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
However, these souls are
unable to rest in peace and still wander about as Undead bound
to this world.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
然而，这些灵魂无法安息，至今仍作为不死系魔物徘徊于世间，被束缚于此。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
These monsters cannot be classified with other monsters that have mutated from living creatures, so our wise and benevolent ruler, King Tristram III, has taken a great interest in Payon's Undead.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
这些魔物无法归类为其他由生物变异而来的魔物，因此我们英明仁慈的统治者，国王特里斯特兰三世，对斐扬的不死系魔物产生了极大的兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
After all, some of these
Undead used to belong to
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
毕竟，其中一些不死系魔物生前曾属于卢恩·米德加兹王国。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
As his subjects,
King Tristram III
feels some responsibility
to release their souls.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
作为他的臣民，国王特里斯特兰三世感到有责任释放它们的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
His Majesty has been supporting
us in our search to discover how to eliminate all of the Undead in this world. We will try to accomplish this goal as soon as we
possibly can.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
陛下一直在支持我们寻找消除世间所有不死系魔物的方法。我们将尽快实现这一目标。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
For the safety of our people,
for the sake of their bereaved families, and in accordance with King Tristram III's order, we must succeed!
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
为了人民的安全，为了逝者家属的安宁，并遵照国王特里斯特兰三世的命令，我们必须成功！

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
As you may well know,
monsters have been endlessly spawning in this world, and the threat of their attacks is grows greater every day.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
如您所知，魔物在这个世界上不断生成，它们袭击的威胁每天都在加剧。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
In response to this,
 the Monster Research
Organization has been formed.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
为了应对这一情况，怪物研究组织成立了。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
Talented people around the world have joined forces in an effort to deduce the origin of monsters, and a way to eliminate them once and for all.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
世界各地的天才们联合起来，致力于推导出魔物的起源，并找到一劳永逸消除它们的方法。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
Of course, it's not
as easy as you would may believe. Many have sacrificed their lives in the pursuit of this knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
当然，这并不像您想象的那样容易。许多人为追求这一知识而献出了生命。

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
In our missions, the number of victims of monster attacks have been countless. Still, nothing can stop us. If our suffering can save humanity, so be it!
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
在我们的任务中，魔物袭击的受害者数不胜数。尽管如此，没有什么能阻止我们。如果我们的苦难能拯救人类，那就这样吧！

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
^666666*Ahem*^000000 My apologies, I get too excited sometimes. But if you happen to meet other scholars such as myself, please treat them well. Our jobs are very difficult!
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者 维科克]
^666666*咳咳*^000000 抱歉，我有时太激动了。但如果您遇到像我这样的学者，请善待他们。我们的工作非常艰难！

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
This place is always bustling with busy people. Little Novices come and go to become Archers, and everyone else is buying arrows while I have to stay here in this small shop.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
这里总是忙碌的人群川流不息。小小的初心者来来去去，想要成为弓箭手，其他人都在买箭矢，而我只能待在这个小店里。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
And I'm sick and tired of making this noodle soup. I have to shower all the time so I can get rid of the smell. And it's not so easy
to get rid of.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
我受够了做这种面汤。我必须经常洗澡才能去掉那股味道。而且那味道很难去除。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
I feel so...
Bored.
And lonely...
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
我觉得好...
无聊。
而且孤独...

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
Where I can find the right person, a hot and Sexy hunk who can take me away from here? Um, hey mister, are you listening?
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
我哪里能找到对的人呢，一个性感又帅气的家伙，能带我离开这里？嗯，嘿，先生，你在听吗？

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
Where I can find the right person, a cute, yet hard-bodied hunk who can take me away from here?
Um, hey lady, are
you listening?
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
我哪里能找到对的人呢，一个可爱又结实的家伙，能带我离开这里？
嗯，嘿，女士，你在听吗？

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
The old fortune teller told me that I'd have great luck in the near future! But what's wrong with me? I'm just living day to day. Maybe I'm just dumb and wishy-washy.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
年老的占卜师告诉我，我最近会有好运！但我到底怎么了？我每天都在浑浑噩噩地过日子。也许我只是个笨蛋，优柔寡断。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
I'm so sorry,
I've said too much.
Now I'm just acting stupid.
I'm sorry you had to listen
to all that.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
非常抱歉，
我话太多了。
现在只是在说傻话。
抱歉让您听了这些。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
So...
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
那么...
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Have you ever heard of Zombies?
scripts.translation: 你听说过腐尸吗？

scripts.text: Fortune Teller...?
scripts.translation: 占卜师...？

scripts.text: I needs some booze.
scripts.translation: 我需要一些酒。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
Of course I've
heard of Zombies!
This is Payon, after all.
Zombies are the walking
Undead, and you can easily
find them around here.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
我当然听说过腐尸！
毕竟这里是斐扬。
腐尸是行走的亡灵，
你在这里很容易就能找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
I hear that they fear holiness, so Archers prefer to use arrow made out of silver, a holy metal, against them.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
我听说它们畏惧神圣，所以弓箭手更喜欢用银制的箭矢来对付它们，因为银是一种神圣的金属。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
Legend says that the chief of this town used silver arrows against Zombies that used to be his brethren in order to release their souls so that they may rest in peace.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
传说这座城镇的首领曾用银箭矢射杀那些曾经是同胞的腐尸，以释放它们的灵魂，让它们得以安息。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
We believe that exorcising
Zombies in this way will lead them peacefully to the afterlife. Their souls no longer need to anguish.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
我们相信，以这种方式驱除腐尸，能让它们平静地前往来世。它们的灵魂不再需要受苦。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
You might not share our beliefs, but my grandfather was one of the Undead. I appreciate that the chief was able to free him from being bound to the world of the living.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
你可能不认同我们的信仰，但我祖父曾是亡灵之一。我很感激首领能让他从生者的世界中解脱出来。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
Oh! Our fortune teller is a really extraordinary person. Well, she doesn't hang around here as
much as she used to do.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
哦！我们的占卜师是个非常非凡的人。不过，她不像以前那样常在这里待着了。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
She used to stay here to tell fortunes for our patrons, but ever since the chief recognized her talents, she now stays in the Central Palace. So you'd better go there if you want to see her.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
她以前常在这里为客人占卜，但自从首领认可了她的才能后，她现在住在中央宫。所以如果你想见她，最好去那里。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
You...
needs some
booze, eh?
Don't we all?
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
你...
需要一些酒，是吗？
谁不想要呢？

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
But I'm so sorry, we sold out.
And we can't afford to prepare alcohol anymore because of the hostile creatures out there. But please come again later. I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
但很抱歉，我们卖完了。
而且由于外面的敌对生物，我们也负担不起再准备酒精饮料的费用了。请稍后再来。抱歉给您带来不便。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
Have a nice
day, dearie.
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
祝你今天愉快，亲爱的。

scripts.text:
[Pub Lady]
^666666*Sob*^000000
When will I be romanced
by my perfectly formed,
yet well read man?
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
^666666*抽泣*^000000
什么时候才能被那位身材完美、
又博学多才的男人追求呢？

scripts.text:
[Chief Guardsman]
What brings
you here?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵队长]
什么事？

scripts.text:
[Chief Guardsman]
I can see that you are not one of the Payon locals. I would just like to remind you to conduct yourself in an orderly manner. Remember,
you are a guest here.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵队长]
我看出来你不是斐扬的当地人。我只想提醒你，请保持秩序。记住，
你是这里的客人。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guardsman]
In the interest of protecting the public peace, I will disarm your equipment. Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵队长]
为了维护公共秩序，我将没收你的装备。谢谢你的配合。

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
I'm kind of worried
about one of my pals.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
我有点担心
我的一个朋友。

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
Even though he's an expert at archery, no one likes his motor mouth. Even our chief is getting fed up with him!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
虽然他射箭技术高超，
但没人喜欢他那张嘴。
连我们的首领都对他感到厌烦了！

scripts.text: Your friend?
scripts.translation: 你的朋友？

scripts.text: Payon has a chief?
scripts.translation: 斐扬有首领？

scripts.text: Motor... Mouth?
scripts.translation: 嘴... 很碎？

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
Ah, right. This buddy of mine is the number one archer in Payon.
He teaches newbie Archers around the Archer Village. It might be a good idea to talk to him at least once.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
啊，对。我的这位朋友是斐扬第一的弓箭手。
他在弓箭手村教新手弓箭手。最好至少和他谈一次话。

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
Our chief lives in the Central Palace. I guess you can say that he's the spiritual guide of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
我们的首领住在中央宫。可以说他是斐扬的灵魂指引者。

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
He used to menace the monsters in Payon Forest, carrying his Gakkung. I remember watching him fight when I was just a little kid.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
他以前带着他的加昆，在斐扬树林里吓唬魔物。我记得小时候看过他战斗。

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
But now he
seems old and weak.
Still, his eyes are as sharp as they used to be during his days
of battle, where he'd never miss
a target.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
但现在他
看起来又老又弱。
不过，他的眼神依然像当年战斗时那样锐利，
从不失手。

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
I admire our chief
from the bottom
of my heart.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
我从心底里
敬佩我们的首领。

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
You don't know
what a motormouth is...?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
你不知道
什么是碎嘴子...？

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
Motormouth
Noun. Some fool who chatters
way too much about stuff that doesn't really matter and doesn't know when to stop.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
碎嘴子
名词。指那些对无关紧要的事情喋喋不休，
且不知道何时该停下来的傻瓜。

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
But yeah, my pal is not only
a legend at archery, he's also well known for how long he's let that mouth of his run.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
不过，我的朋友不仅射箭是传奇，
还以那张嘴能一直说个不停而闻名。

scripts.text:
[Archer Zakk]
Anyway, my pal Wolt doesn't have
a place of his own, so he stays at the Inn. Why don't you go and meet him? He's actually an okay guy if you can stand all the chatter.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 扎克]
总之，我的朋友沃尔特没有自己的住处，所以住在旅馆里。你不妨去见见他？如果你能忍受他那些唠叨的话，他其实是个不错的人。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Archers should
practice as much
as they can. Otherwise,
they'll never become experts.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
弓箭手应该
尽可能多地练习。
否则，
他们永远无法成为专家。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Oh, hey there!
I'm Wolt the Archer,
but, erm, you can
just call me 'Wolt.'
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
哦，你好！
我是弓箭手沃尔特，
不过，呃，你
可以直接叫我“沃尔特”。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
I know this is a bit of an unexpected question, but do
you tend to spend a lot of your
time in idleness?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
我知道这个问题有点突然，但你
平时是不是花很多时间
在无所事事？

scripts.text: Oh, hell no.
scripts.translation: 绝对没有。

scripts.text: Yeah. I guess...
scripts.translation: 是的。我想...是。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Ooh. That's good. In fact, that's great! If only all of us Archers had that kind of attitude. If you have time to just sit around, then you have the time to go out and practice!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
噢。那很好。事实上，那太棒了！如果所有弓箭手都有这种态度就好了。如果你有时间闲坐着，那你就有时间出去练习！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Yeah...
As Archers, we kind of look
down on people who slack off
on the training.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
是啊...
作为弓箭手，我们
其实有点瞧不起
那些训练时偷懒的人。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
If you don't work hard, then you'll end up being a horrible Archer. No one can depend on your aim!
I mean, nobody!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
如果不努力训练，你就会变成一个糟糕的弓箭手。没人能指望你的箭术！
我是说，谁都不行！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Did you ask how we go about
our training? Well, the Archers of Payon don't have much time to just play around with their Bows.
I guess we go out and
engage in actual fighting.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
你问我们是怎么训练的？嗯，斐扬的弓箭手可没那么多时间拿着弓玩耍。
我想我们得出去
进行真正的战斗。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
So we just carry out Bows wherever we go, and spend all day looking for monsters to kill. Oh, and after we find some monsters, we
kill them of course. That almost goes without saying.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
所以我们走到哪里都带着弓，整天都在找魔物杀。哦，找到魔物之后，
当然是要杀掉它们。这还用说吗。

scripts.text: I guess you'd need a good Bow.
scripts.translation: 我想你需要一把好弓。

scripts.text: You call that 'practice?!'
scripts.translation: 这也叫“练习”？！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
That's right!
An Archer depends
on the strength
of his Bow!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
没错！
弓箭手
全靠弓的
威力！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Bows constructed in Payon
are the greatest on this continent! They are light and stout, made out of high quality tree Trunks from Payon Forest!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
斐扬制造的弓
是这片大陆上最好的！它们轻便坚固，是用斐扬树林的高品质树干制成的！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
The quality of the wood often determines the quality of the Bow. My lil' sweety was made out of a walnut tree, and is strong enough to bear thousands of pounds
of force.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
木材的质量往往决定了弓的质量。我的小甜心是用胡桃木做的，坚固得足以承受数千磅的拉力。

scripts.text:
[Arche Wolt]
Oh, oh! And my Bow's stylish as well. It comes in a sophisticated ebony color, and I just look so cool and heroic while I'm killing monsters~!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
噢，噢！而且我的弓也很时尚。它是精致的乌木色，我一边杀魔物一边看起来既酷又英勇~！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Oh, and the trees in Payon Forest are famous for the quality of their wood. But then, more and more of them have been turning into monsters. Is this the work of evil forces?!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
哦，斐扬树林的树木以木材质量闻名。但是，越来越多的树变成了魔物。这是邪恶力量的杰作吗？！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
It's a pity because the tree monsters used to be beautiful, majestic trees. But then it's okay if we kill them, so that we can make Bows out of their wood.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
真可惜，那些树魔物以前都是美丽、雄伟的大树。不过没关系，我们可以杀掉它们，用它们的木头做弓。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
And then we use these Bows to kill even more tree monsters... And then make more wood! Mwahahahaha! It's an endless cycle!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
然后我们用这些弓去杀更多的树魔物... 然后再做更多的木头！哇哈哈哈！这是个无尽的循环！

scripts.text: ^666666*Ahem!*^000000 Speaking of endless...

[Archer Wolt]
Yeah...
You're right.
Monsters are everywhere,
can you believe it?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
是啊...
你说得对。
魔物到处都是，
你能相信吗？

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Do you understand
why the Archer Village
was built where it is?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
你知道
弓箭手村
为什么建在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
To the West, near Archer Village, you'll see Payon Cave. Inside the cave, an enormous amount of monster endlessly spawn without showing any sign of slowing down.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
在西边，靠近弓箭手村的地方，你会看到斐扬洞穴。洞穴里，大量的魔物源源不断地刷新，丝毫没有减少的迹象。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
We Archers are here to protect our territory against them, as ordered by our honorable chief!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
我们弓箭手在这里保护我们的领地，免受它们的侵害，这是遵照我们尊敬的首领的命令！

scripts.text: Cave, you say?
scripts.translation: 洞穴？

scripts.text: Chief...?
Oh man, I hate this town!
scripts.translation: 天哪，我讨厌这个城镇！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
If you head North
of town, you'll find
Payon Cave.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
如果你往城镇北边走，
就能找到斐扬洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Once inside, you'll encounter all sorts lots of ugly monsters. Like those nasty looking Bats, and
those Zombies...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
一旦进去，你就会遇到各种各样丑陋的魔物。
比如那些长相凶恶的蝙蝠，
还有那些腐尸...

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
If we let them out of that place, they'd run all over Payon! So, we gotta get in there and clean that place up of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
如果我们放任它们出来，
它们就会跑遍整个斐扬！
所以，我们必须进去把那里的魔物清理干净。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
But since these monsters endlessly respawn, sometimes I feel like we're wasting our time and energy for nothing...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
但是，因为这些魔物会无限刷新，
有时候我觉得我们是在白费力气...

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Whoa...
Alright, I think yet my mouth run
a marathon again. I better let you go. There's lots of training to do, and plenty of monsters to kill!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
哇...
好吧，我觉得我的嘴又跑马拉松了。
我最好让你走了。
还有很多训练要做，还有大量的魔物要杀！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Our chief? Ah, he's such a swell guy. Then again, he's always scolds me for talking too much.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
我们的首领？啊，他是个很棒的人。
不过，他总是因为我话太多而责备我。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
He always working to make sure
that Payon is safe from harm. Lately, I've been worried since he hasn't been coming out the Palace lately. That might be a bad sign.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
他一直在努力确保斐扬的安全。
最近，我有点担心，因为他最近没有从宫殿出来。这可能不是个好兆头。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
A bad sign of what, I'm not really sure. There could be problems with Payon, or maybe he's got something he needs to handle on his own. Anyway, there's always guards in his room for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
不是什么坏兆头，我也不太确定。
斐扬可能有问题，或者他有什么事需要独自处理。
总之，他的房间里总是有卫兵守着，不知为什么。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Heh heh heh~
I'll get in trouble if he knows
I told an outsider know too much about his affairs. Oh well! It's too late. I already told you! There's no use regretting it!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
嘿嘿嘿~
如果他知道我对外人说了这么多他的私事，我会惹上麻烦的。
算了！已经太晚了。我已经告诉你了！后悔也没用！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
But...
It's not too late for me to just shut my mouth. Keep it closed. Shutting up now. Quiet as a mouse. Seeya later~!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
但是...
现在闭上嘴还来得及。保持沉默。现在闭嘴了。像老鼠一样安静。再见~！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Hmm...?
And you don't?
What better practice
than the real, honest
to goodness thing?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
嗯...？
你不觉得吗？
还有什么比真实的、
货真价实的实战更好的练习呢？

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Though, you may have a point
there. I mean, you should be able to practice without having to suffer serious consequences.
You know, like death.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
不过，你可能说得对。
我是说，你应该能在不遭受严重后果的情况下练习。
你知道，比如死亡。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
But we've gotta make do
with what we've got!
An Archer's life is
endless training!
Endless practice!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
但我们必须利用现有的条件！
弓箭手的生活就是无尽的训练！
无尽的练习！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Hm...?
Are you tired of me repeating the same thing over and over again?
Oh, just bear with me. Think of it as practicing your patience~
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
嗯...？
你厌倦了我一遍又一遍地重复同样的话吗？
哦，请忍耐一下。把它当作练习耐心~

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Eh...
I guess it's important
to set aside time to rest.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
呃...
我想留出时间休息是很重要的。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
But it's also a good idea to set aside time for practicing and training, and practicing and training!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
但留出时间进行练习和训练，以及练习和训练，也是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
And it's a very bad idea to rest when you should be alert, or well, when you're supposed to be doing something else.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
而在应该保持警惕的时候休息，或者当你应该做其他事情的时候休息，是非常糟糕的主意。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
That reminds me of the time
I set fire to my house during the holidays. It was an accident, of course, but boy, were my folks angry!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
这让我想起有一次，
我在假期期间把房子烧了。当然，那是个意外，但天哪，我家人气坏了！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Hahahaha~
It all started when I decided to take a bath. Here, in Payon, we use the old style baths, so we need to make a fire to heat the water. Cold baths are just so uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
哈哈哈~
一切始于我决定洗个澡。在这里，斐扬，我们使用老式浴池，所以我们需要生火来加热水。冷水澡太不舒服了。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
But nice, warm baths are veeeery comfortable. That was probably the best bath I had in my life! It was so comfortable, I fell asleep.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
不过，温暖舒适的澡真的非常舒服。那大概是我这辈子洗过最舒服的澡了！舒服得我都睡着了。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
But while I was sleeping,
I guess I didn't notice the fire reach the floor, walls and ceiling! Luckily, I was in a tub full of water, so I was okay.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
但在我睡着的时候，
我大概没注意到火已经烧到了地板、墙壁和天花板！幸好我泡在装满水的浴缸里，所以没事。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
I would've gotten help if it weren't for the fact that the fire had burned my clothes while I was napping. So, of course, I couldn't just run around town in the nude.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
如果不是因为火在我打盹时把我的衣服烧了，我早就去求助了。所以，我当然不能光着身子在镇上乱跑。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
So...
I just sat in the water for about an hour, completely naked, and yelling 'Help me,' until someone could hear me.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
所以...
我就光着身子坐在水里，大概坐了一个小时，一直大喊“救命”，直到有人能听到我。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
But, it turned out that no one could hear me. Luckily, our roof caved in and totally demolished our walls so that my screams could finally reach passerby. And it was in that way that I survived.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
但结果没人能听到我。幸好，我们的屋顶塌了，把墙壁也彻底拆毁了，这样我的尖叫声终于能传到路人耳中。就是这样，我才活了下来。

scripts.text: Um, what's the point of that story?
scripts.translation: 呃，讲这个故事有什么意义吗？

scripts.text: I guess I better not get lazy then.
scripts.translation: 看来我最好别偷懒了。

scripts.text: Blah blah blah. See ya.
scripts.translation: 啰嗦。再见。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Oh...
Umm...
You mean, like,
the moral of the story?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
哦...
呃...
你是说，
这个故事的寓意？

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Resting during the right times is perfectly fine. Just don't go and take a break when you shouldn't. That kind of behavior would make anyone in our town angry!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
在合适的时候休息完全没问题。只是别在不该休息的时候休息。这种行为会让镇上任何人生气！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Our chief is especially annoyed by that kind of irresponsible attitude. I guess, around here, only the town drunkard subscribes to that kind of policy.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
我们的首领尤其讨厌这种不负责任的态度。我想，在这里，只有镇上的酒鬼才认同这种作风。

scripts.text: Chief?
scripts.translation: 首领？

scripts.text: Town Drunkard?
scripts.translation: 镇上的酒鬼？

scripts.text: Man, you talk too much!
scripts.translation: 天哪，你话太多了！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Our chief? Ah, he's such a swell guy. Then again, he's always scolds me for talking too much.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
我们的首领？啊，他是个很棒的人。
不过，他总是因为我话太多而责备我。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
He always working to make sure
that Payon is safe from harm. Lately, I've been worried since he hasn't been coming out the Palace lately. That might be a bad sign...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
他一直在努力确保斐扬的安全。最近，我有点担心，因为他最近没从宫殿出来过。这可能不是个好兆头...

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
A bad sign of what, I'm not really sure. There could be problems with Payon, or maybe he's got something he needs to handle on his own. Anyway, there's always guards in his room for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
不是什么坏兆头，我也不太确定。
斐扬可能有问题，或者他有什么事需要独自处理。
总之，他的房间里总是有卫兵守着，不知为什么。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Heh heh heh~
I'll get in trouble if he knows
I told an outsider know too much about his affairs. Oh well! It's too late. I already told you! There's no use regretting it!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
嘿嘿嘿~
如果他知道我对外人说了这么多他的私事，我会惹上麻烦的。
算了！已经太晚了。我已经告诉你了！后悔也没用！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
But...
It's not too late for me to just shut my mouth. Complete silence. I'm not even opening my mouth. Starting right about... Now!
Seeya later~!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
但是...
我现在闭嘴还来得及。完全沉默。我甚至不张嘴。就从...现在！
再见~！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
You know...
The guy in the pub.
Loud, and obnoxious
and annoying to liste--
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
你知道...
酒馆里那个人。
很吵，很讨厌，
而且很烦人，听他说话--

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Hmm...?
What's that look for?
Anyway, when I have
some spare cash, I try
to buy him a drink.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
嗯...？
你那个表情是什么意思？
总之，当我手头有点闲钱时，我会试着请他喝一杯。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Still...
It's not a good
idea to drink so much.
Or as much as he does...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
不过...
喝那么多酒可不是什么好主意。
或者像他喝得那么多...

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
...!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
...！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
...
I...
B-but...!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
...
我...
但...！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Oh good~!
I guess you got
the point of my story!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
太好了~！
看来你听懂我故事的重点了！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
We, as Archers, put a lot of importance on training and practice, so we kind of look
down on people who aren't
diligent at all.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
我们弓箭手非常重视训练和练习，所以有点瞧不起那些完全不勤奋的人。

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
Still...
I have to admit that, at heart,
I'm a pretty lazy guy. I guess it's pretty amazing that someone like
me can even be an Archer!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
不过...
我得承认，我骨子里是个挺懒散的人。像我这样的人居然能当上弓箭手，真是挺不可思议的！

scripts.text:
[Archer Wolt]
In any case,
whatever you do
in life, do it
with passion!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 沃尔特]
总之，
无论你在生活中做什么，
都要充满热情！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hey...
Hey...!
Show your respect
to our chief!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
嘿...
嘿...！
请对我们的首领保持尊重！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hey...
Hey...!
Show your respect
to our chief!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
嘿...
嘿...！
请对我们的首领保持尊重！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Heeeey!
I said...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
嘿！
我说...

scripts.text:
[Chief]
It's fine, it's fine.
It's been a long time
since I've spoken to
such young people.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
没关系，没关系。
我已经很久没和这么年轻的人说话了。

scripts.text: Please tell me about Payon.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我关于斐扬的事。

scripts.text: Where are the guards from?
scripts.translation: 卫兵们是从哪里来的？

scripts.text: Please tell me about the cave.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我关于洞穴的事。

scripts.text: What does an Archer do?
scripts.translation: 弓箭手是做什么的？

scripts.text: What does a Hunter do?
scripts.translation: 猎人是做什么的？

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Payon is the city of highlanders. As long as our history can relate, our city has been self-sufficient.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
斐扬是高地的城市。只要我们的历史还能追溯，我们的城市就一直自给自足。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Although our ancestors did not enjoy the benefits of cultural exchange with the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom as we do today, they knew how to make a living without
any help.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
虽然我们的祖先没有像我们今天这样享受与卢恩·米德加兹王国文化交流的好处，但他们知道如何在没有任何帮助的情况下谋生。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Payon has developed its own cultures and ways. We've invented our own means to protect ourselves against the elements, and Payon men and women train as Archers and Hunters to defend themselves.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
斐扬发展出了自己的文化和生活方式。我们发明了自己的方法来抵御恶劣天气，斐扬的男女都接受弓箭手和猎人的训练来保卫自己。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
I've heard of weak, cowardly
young people who fear the fields or dungeons filled with monsters. But to us, battle is a way of life.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
我听说过一些软弱、胆小的年轻人，他们害怕充满魔物的田野或地下城。但对我们来说，战斗是一种生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
That is why his Majesty, King Tristram III wishes for us to train young people how to effectively fight against evil creatures.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
这就是为什么特里斯特姆三世陛下希望我们训练年轻人如何有效地对抗邪恶生物。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Even since I was young,
Prontera has sent civil
servants and envoys to Payon.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
从我年轻的时候起，
普隆德拉就派遣文职人员和使节到斐扬。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Royal troops, Kafra Ladies, Guards... At first, there was conflict brought about by differences in our customs
and cultures.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
皇家军队、卡普拉女士、卫兵...起初，由于习俗和文化的差异，产生了一些冲突。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
However, as time passed,
we've been able to resolve such petty differences. I cannot deny that they've helped us speedily develop our trade with foreign nations.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
不过，随着时间推移，我们已能化解这些琐碎的分歧。不可否认，他们帮助我们迅速发展与外国的贸易。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Now, people who used to be outsiders are now bonifide Payon citizens. When I was young, I would never imagined such a thing possible. Hahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[首领]
如今，曾经的外来者已成为真正的斐扬市民。在我年轻时，我从未想过会有这样的一天。哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Chief]
It pleases me to see and meet with them. Even though have come from other places, they have a love for Payon that is as sincere as my own.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
见到并结识他们让我感到欣慰。尽管他们来自其他地方，但他们对斐扬的热爱与我一样真挚。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Ah...
I used to go to the cave
to the North sometimes. But it
is harder now than it was then.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
啊...
我年轻时偶尔会去北边的洞穴。但现在那里比那时更难对付了。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Evil creatures that I've never seen before endlessly respawn in that place. The monsters in Payon Cave today are different than the ones we used to fight with.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
那里不断刷新着我从未见过的邪恶生物。如今斐扬洞穴里的魔物，与我们过去战斗的那些已经不同了。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Have you ever happened to see
the Zombies...? Some of them are warriors who entered the cave to protect this village, but never came back.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
你见过那些腐尸吗？其中一些是进入洞穴保护村庄的战士，但他们再也没有回来。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Although they are a threat, some of those Undead are also victims of that cave. I'm too old to endure that kind of pain...
scripts.translation:
[首领]
虽然它们构成了威胁，但那些不死者中也有洞穴的受害者。我年纪大了，无法承受那种痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Chief]
I must do anything I can to stop the Undead, and release their souls from eternal anguish.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
我必须尽我所能阻止不死者，并将他们的灵魂从永恒的痛苦中释放出来。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Ah, it is fortunate that archery is a specialty here in Payon. Because of the surrounding forest, we have an abundant supply of wood to create Bows.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
啊，幸运的是，弓箭是斐扬的专长。由于周围森林茂密，我们有充足的木材来制作弓。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
The forest also is a good training place for Archers to learn how to use their environment to impede the advance of their enemies while attacking from a safe distance.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
森林也是弓箭手训练的好地方，让他们学会利用环境阻碍敌人的推进，同时从安全距离发起攻击。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
The forest can also be convenient in unexpected ways. When I was young, I ran out of arrows while fighting against monsters in the woods, but arrows dropped by other monsters saved my life! Mwahah!
scripts.translation:
[首领]
森林有时也能带来意想不到的便利。我年轻时在树林里与魔物战斗，箭用光了，但其他魔物掉落的箭救了我的命！哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Chief]
As foreign cultures were introduced to Payon, changes have been brought about to our battle style.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
随着外来文化传入斐扬，我们的战斗风格也发生了变化。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Technology, especially that of explosives, enabled new methods
of battle. We were no longer limited to the use of just bows and arrows.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
技术，尤其是爆炸物技术，带来了新的战斗方式。我们不再局限于只使用弓箭。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Trapping skills, which make
hunting monsters much easier, were developed enable here in Payon. Experts in the new skills were dubbed 'Hunters' by our previous Chief.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
陷阱技能让狩猎魔物变得更加容易，这项技能在斐扬得到发展。精通新技能的人被前任首领称为“猎人”。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
Although highly effective, trapping is a really dangerous skill if not used properly. That's why we do not approve of the inexperienced becoming Hunters.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
虽然陷阱非常有效，但如果使用不当，这是一种非常危险的技能。因此，我们不批准没有经验的人成为猎人。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
However, we welcome people
who have proven to be capable to take the challenge of the Hunter class.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
不过，我们欢迎那些证明自己有实力的人接受猎人职业的考验。

scripts.text:
[Chief]
So tired...
I'd better rest.
Please, take care
of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
好累...
我最好休息一下。
请保重。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hey...!
You're not
allowed here!
Go back outside!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
嘿...！
你不允许在这里！
回到外面去！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I'm sorry,
but you're
not allowed here.
Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
抱歉，
你不允许在这里。
请离开。

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
Payon!
Such a wonderful
place! Superb Bows
and skillful Archers!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
斐扬！
多么美妙的地方！
出色的弓和技艺高超的弓箭手！

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
Hey you~!
Have you heard
of famous Payon?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
嘿，你~！
你听说过
著名的斐扬吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, of course~!
scripts.translation: 是啊，当然~！

scripts.text: Pay...on?

[Archer Joe]
Oh! You the man!
You know the Archers of Payon!
We never miss our target! Even from a distance, the hearts of our foes are unsafe!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
哦！你真是个人才！
你知道斐扬的弓箭手吗！
我们从不失手！即使距离再远，敌人的心脏也毫无安全可言！

scripts.text: So, you like this place, huh?
scripts.translation: 所以，你喜欢这个地方，是吧？

scripts.text: Hahahaha~
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
Yes! I love this place!
I love this city so much,
I've even been doing research on it! If there's anything you wanna know about Payon, please ask me!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
没错！我爱死这个地方了！
我这么喜欢这座城，
甚至对它做了研究！如果你想知道关于斐扬的什么，尽管问我！

scripts.text: The people wear unique clothing here.
scripts.translation: 这里的人穿着独特的衣服。

scripts.text: What's the building in the middle of town?
scripts.translation: 城镇中间的那栋建筑是什么？

scripts.text: Who's that guy drinking over there?
scripts.translation: 那边那个在喝酒的家伙是谁？

scripts.text: Talk to you later.
scripts.translation: 回头再聊。

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
Yes, I agree.
You must know this place used to be isolated because of the thick forests and the mountainous area.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
是的，我同意。
你应该知道，这个地方过去因为茂密的森林和山区而与世隔绝。

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
Because of that, the Payon developed a culture of its own, which is quite different than that of the rest of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
因此，斐扬发展出了自己独特的文化，这与卢恩·米德加兹其他地方的文化大不相同。

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
This garment is traditional Payon clothing! Why don't you try wearing one? It's very comfortable~
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
这是斐扬的传统服饰！你要不要试试穿一件？非常舒服~

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
You mean the Central Palace? Strangers aren't allowed to enter that place. People say the royal family and their friends from outside gather there.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
你是说中央宫吗？外人是不允许进入那里的。据说王室成员和他们的外地朋友会在那里聚会。

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
I'd like to go there sometime, and see what it's like on the inside!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
我也想去那里看看，想知道里面是什么样子的！

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
Oh! That guy's notorious!
Whatever you do, don't treat
him to any drinks!
You'll regret it!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
哦！那个家伙很有名！
无论如何，别请他喝酒！
你会后悔的！

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
Okay!
See ya!
Catch you later!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
好的！
再见！
回头见！

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
What a shame...
How have you not
heard of the Payon Archers?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
真遗憾...
你怎么会没听说过
斐扬的弓箭手呢？

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
Well, when you 
learn more about us,
let's talk again and I can tell you why the Payon Archers are
so great!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
好吧，等你
多了解我们一些，
我们再聊，我可以告诉你为什么斐扬的弓箭手
这么厉害！

scripts.text:
[Archer Joe]
Why are
you so quiet?
You're not shy, are you?
Come on, there's no reason
to be bashful around me~
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手 乔]
你怎么这么安静？
不会是害羞吧？
别不好意思嘛，在我面前不用拘束~
